witness.report: outline: excised 3 block(s) at 0x40100a into outlined_0x40100a() (1 argument(s), 1 result(s))

speed_method: interleaved min-of-N, 11 samples per arm, alternating arm order, 2 discarded warmup rounds. scripts.pipeline.timeit runs all OFF samples then all ON samples and on this box reported -31.94% for a pass that cannot make anything faster, so the arms are interleaved here. Three arms measured: no option at all, `off`, and a supplied region. The pass returns immediately unless a region names the current function, so the cost of it merely existing is +0.07% - indistinguishable from noise. The `region` arm's negative min and positive median bracket zero, which is what a sub-noise effect looks like on a 165 ms baseline.

sweep.reason: the option is address-keyed and default-off: with no region supplied the pass returns before touching anything, and with a region supplied it no-ops on every function the spec does not name. The set of functions whose C changes under the shipped default is empty; both parity gates confirm it.

bugs_found_building_it: liveness direction: counting any outside read as live-out flagged the entry block's own flag test, which happens BEFORE the region, and rejected every candidate. Fixed by computing over the region's continuation (blocks reachable from the exit).

sub-register aliasing: an x86 32-bit write zero-extends, so SLEIGH writes both EAX and RAX at one offset and a (space,offset,size) key counted one register as two live-outs. Fixed by merging overlapping storage.
branch operands: slot 0 of a control-transfer op is its destination, a varnode in the code space; counting it made every conditional look like a memory read (ram+0x401015:1 appeared as a live-in).

node_split_block_edge is a DUPLICATION primitive, not an edge splitter: it copy_basic_range's the target's p-code and inherits its successors (it exists for tail duplication). Using it produced a clone of the region head whose out-edges pointed back into the region, and heritage failed with 'non-root block has no idom'. Replaced with new_block_basic + switch_edge + add_edge and no remove_branch/push_branch.

a hand-built FuncCallSpecs has no prototype store, so every later FuncProto::store query panics; decoder-produced specs get theirs from ActionDefaultParams. Fixed with proto_mut().attach_internal_store(void_ty).

the pass was first scheduled between varnodeprops and heritage, splitting a ported C++ adjacency (coreaction.cc:5751-5756) pinned by verify_w8x_allowlist.rs. Moved before varnodeprops; the pre-SSA self-gate makes the position equivalent.
